sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Alok Kumar,Shachi Singh Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Syed Aftab Husain Rizvi,J.

This petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the First Information Report registered as Case Crime No.398 of 2023, under Sections 406, 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B IPC, Police Station - Muradnagar, District -Ghaziabad, primarily on the ground that inquiry under the provision of Section 95(1)(g) of U.P. Panchayat Raj Act, 1947 has since been initiated, therefore, till its conclusion, no F.I.R. can be registered against the petitioner for alleged offence of misappropriation of funds.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance upon the provisions of Section 95(1)(g) of Uttar Pradesh U.P. Panchayat Raj Act, 1947 and U. P. Panchayat Raj (Removal of Pradhans, Up Pradhans and Members) Enquiry, Rules, 1997, in order to submit that inquiry is required to be conducted, by the District Level Officer, to be authorized by District Magistrate and only thereafter any step can be taken in the matter.

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Navneet Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Sri Rahul Sripat, learned counsel for the informant states that provisions of Panchayat Raj Act, 1947 and Rules 1997, in respect of proceeding for removal of Pradhan, operate in entirely distinct field,
vis-a-vis allegations of misappropriate of funds.
Submission is that provisions of Act 1947 and Rules 1997 cannot be pressed into service so as to challenge the F.I.R.

We find substance in the objection, raised by the respondents' counsel, inasmuch as lodgement of the F.I.R. is not, in any manner, connected with holding of proceedings for removal of the Pradhan,
which are regulated by separate statutory provisions.

The prayer made to quash the F.I.R., in such circumstances, is declined, particularly as prima facie allegations of commissioning of cognizable offence is disclosed in the F.I.R.
Writ petition is dismissed, accordingly.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 MN/-
